scope: Preserve existing files only. No repository, fixture, product, GUI, benchmark or CI command was executed or modified during archival.
statusMeaning: Statuses describe each original historical record, not milestone acceptance. Invalid controls, expected identity failures and missing evidence remain explicit.
excluded: All Q98 and other active logs or desktop evidence

knownLimitations.STATIC_ARCHIVE_ONLY: Only existing evidence bytes were packaged; no acceptance action was performed.
knownLimitations.RECORDER_TEXT_AND_PARTIAL_ENV: Original recorder uses text=True and omits PATH from recorded environment; missing binary capture or environment details were not reconstructed.
knownLimitations.HASH_LIST_SCOPE_DIFFERS: Final before/after lists cover the test source only; committed list additionally covers task documentation. Equality is asserted only for their shared test-file entry.
knownLimitations.NOT_MISSING_NOTIFY_FAILURE: Existing root and final test records are success/exit0. They are not the reportedly earlier unisolated-HOME notify offline failure101 whose raw output is missing.
knownLimitations.NOT_SAME_CONDITION_POSITIVE_CONTROL: Final ordinary 31/0 run uses empty fixture global configuration, not the missing fixed-code useConfigOnly positive control. Later CI cannot retroactively supply that control.
knownLimitations.NO_RECREATED_MISSING_LOGS: Missing fixed-code same-condition positive control and earlier notify failure logs were not recreated. Their absence does not prove those runs never happened; disclosed deletion history is not erased.
knownLimitations.SENSITIVITY_PROVENANCE_PARTIAL: Available sensitivity output, exit text, fixed source and config are preserved. Independent complete argv/environment/timing records do not exist in this selected material.
knownLimitations.OUTER_CONFIG_CONTROL_INVALID: The old-code pass under outer configuration is an invalid sensitivity control because fixture env_clear replaced that configuration.
knownLimitations.DOC_ONLY_NO_PRODUCT_RERUN: f10 is a documentation-only correction; its local validation is diff-check, not another product test.
knownLimitations.DOCUMENTATION_CHECK_METADATA_PARTIAL: Doc correction retains textual exit=0 and hashes but lacks separately recorded exact argv, environment and timing.
knownLimitations.REVIEWS_PRECEDE_CORRECTION: Original Standards and Spec findings cover 2a51...d952 before f10. They are not rewritten as a new zero-finding post-correction review.
knownLimitations.HISTORICAL_PENDING_CI_NOT_CURRENT_STATUS: Historical Windows-pending statements keep their original time boundary; later terminal CI evidence is separately associated.
knownLimitations.DISPATCH_NOT_EXECUTION: Instructions are preserved as instructions, not as proof of execution.
knownLimitations.CI_NOT_DESKTOP_OR_PACKAGING: CI success and release binary compilation do not establish installer publication, Windows desktop, D06, Q98 or whole-M2 acceptance.
knownLimitations.CI_QUERY_METADATA_PARTIAL: CI query/download stdout, stderr and exit are retained but their exact argv, full environment and start/end are not independently recorded. Push has separate command/cwd/time records.
knownLimitations.NONTERMINAL_OBSERVATION_PRESERVED: Earlier successful query still reports the new run in_progress and old failures. It is retained unchanged rather than replaced by terminal status.

recordedSourceComparisons.comparisonScope: Recorded evidence only; no current source tree or Git comparison was run.
